title: The Court Tavern with Tony and Jimmy Cooper
summary: Williams and Tony worked in a gay-nineties tavern built for them behind the Court of Two Sisters on Bourbon Street.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well maybe Lee Kelly come into the Court of Two Sisters when Tony and I was working in the courtyard place, I don't know what they... What was it called?
Huh? That room we were in. Jimmy Cooper built that little place in the back. You're talking about the place on Bourbon? Yeah.
The Court Tavern. The Court Tavern, that's right.
